item.title: Applied Nutrition beats expectations with 50% revenue growth
item.summary: Applied Nutrition said full-year revenue and profit would come in ahead of expectations, and guided to further growth in the year ahead, as the sports nutrition brand’s rapid expansion continued. The company expects revenue for the year to 31 July to have risen 50% to £160m, with adjusted EBITDA up 40% to about £43.3m, beating […] The post Applied Nutrition beats expectations with 50% revenue growth appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
